nominal_scale.kind: nominal art-direction choice, not a newly measured fossil dimension; display scaling separately labeled

budget_intent.policy: 14k triangles and 1,000,000 bytes are ceilings, not targets. Usually aim about 100–500 KB; below this range is fine. Spend more triangles only for visible silhouette/proportion/connection benefit. Do not pad counts or enlarge textures for apparent refinement. Preserve quality if a justified asset exceeds the usual range within the hard caps.

start_gate: Current explicit parent assignment authorizes local recovery only; original pause retained unchanged.
concurrency: Parent-coordinated shared host pool; default one worker x two Blender threads, no per-batch full-host allocation.

geometry_choices.en: Original nominal6m closed sinkhole teaching patch: a full surrounding surface funnels downward into a narrow throat and an enlarged underground cavity. An explicitly artificial front subsurface teaching cutaway reveals the connection while the above-ground funnel rim stays closed all around. Physical void and rock thickness, no painted black hole, water or lights; not a blocked spring mouth, measured site, collapse event, age or hydrological simulation.
geometry_choices.zh: 原创名义6米封闭落水漏斗教学裁片：完整周缘地表真实下凹汇入窄喉并通向下部扩大的地下腔。明确人工前侧地下展示剖切露出连接，同时地表漏斗周缘保持闭合。真实空腔岩厚，非黑贴孔/泉口堵口，无水灯，不指实测地点塌陷事件年代或水文模拟。

geometry_parameters.cuts: Only front underground half removed for teaching. Full surface depression rim retained.
geometry_parameters.construction: One welded watertight solid. Exact seam joins half-underbody to full surface roof; no internal contact faces.
